latest_release.name: PhotoCraft v0.23.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ui): keep the Color Sampler cursor while a sampler is dragged (#13063) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13212
* fix(ui): the Arbitrary angle rounds in f64 and keeps that value (#13067) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13217
* Remove tool: 19 px brush after Reset Tool and on first use by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13151
* Release: PhotoCraft v0.23.0 on main by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13345
* Remove: alert on a pixel layer with Lock All by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13171
* Pen: Undo after finishing a path gives it back to the Pen instead of deleting it (#6619) by @marmitoTH in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6413
* ci: use StepSecurity's maintained actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13337
* macOS signing: decode the certificate into an exclusive temp file by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11028
* Place: refuse a scale that makes the placed image exceed the render pixel limit by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11229
* automation: save_bytes never reads linked files by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11233
* Escape control characters in log lines and diagnostic output taken from files and plug-ins by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11218
* text: charge the rasterizer's output tiles, not only its pixels by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11047
* fix(engine): apply the metadata choice to WebP Quick Export by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11058
* fix(compose): bisect gradient stops, evict oversized effect maps, skip empty distance transforms by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11056
* Camera Raw: read each source row once when building the preview proxy by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11064
* fix(cms): charge decoded CLUT values against a per-profile budget by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11055
* Save: a replacement in another group does not widen group access by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11232
* fix(ui-egui): bound the RAW re-read and treat symlinked names as taken in batch export by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11204
* fix(algo): hold raw filter parameters to their ranges (Water Paper, Box Blur, Lanczos, Camera Raw noise) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11199
* fix(algo): bound EXIF text decoding, warp scans, gallery windows, inpaint sizes, pyramid depth by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11161
* codecs: list each Cryptomatte layer once and index streams by name by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10978
* fix(gpu): cap plan accumulator slots and gradient lookup tables by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11061
* fix(io): charge importers for the whole tiles surfaces keep by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11144
* fix(format,engine): limit zstd windows, set bundle modes via the handle, refuse symlinked presets by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11145
* fix(codecs): checked sizes in encoders, EXR name lookup, FITS float limit, VP8 plane copies, EXIF thumbnail bytes by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11164
* fix(engine): bound sparse remap, scaled clone sources, path reads, export format, name lookups by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11181
* fix(engine): authorization for nested scratch sessions and preset calls, CSV and PostScript text escaping by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/1
